name: Duke Energy
description: Captures the Auth0 mobile-app redirect from Duke Energy's login (cma-prod:// custom scheme, plus the iOS https callback) and forwards the authorization code to Home Assistant. Presents an iPhone Safari User-Agent on the login site, which rejects desktop browsers after the password step.
